kfn.description: Exact k farthest-neighbor search (k=10) over road-network object sets (real POI categories and uniform densities up to d=0.1). Benefit: how few objects a method has to retrieve individually and how few exact network distances it computes, relative to evaluating every object. Constraints: every answer exact, index size and index construction work within budget.
kfn.notes: colt / colt_default / alt_filter / bruteforce rows: this workspace's pipeline in the paper's own setting (scripts/evaluate.sh -> eval/evaluate.py: original NW travel times, the eight real POI categories as published plus uniform d = 0.001, 0.01, 0.1 from the paper's sensitivity analysis, public query seed), job ad607932-ebd. colt uses the paper's Table 8 kFN structure (b=4, m=4, Slice landmarks, 16 ALT root landmarks) and lambda=16, chosen by the paper's own procedure (parameter testing, Section 9.6) on this network's public train split (method/tuned_lambda.json; the paper's 256 was tuned on its 22x larger network); colt_default uses the paper's untuned defaults (b=8, m=2, Random, lambda=256). Candidates count individually retrieved objects plus opened non-empty index nodes (the paper counts objects only); calls count every exact distance, including those to landmarks (the paper counts distances to objects only). Scale: the NW subset (1.09M vertices) of the paper's 24M-vertex US network, Dijkstra instead of PHL, so the paper's numbers are kept under _paper_* keys: read off the paper's log-scale Figure 11c/11d (continental US, uniform objects at d=0.0001, ~2.4k objects), approximate.

log10_candidate_reduction.description: Mean over queries of log10((|P|+1)/(candidates+1)), floored at 0. Candidates = objects revealed individually + non-empty index nodes accessed; 0 = every object retrieved individually.

log10_call_reduction.description: Mean over queries of log10((|Q||P|+1)/(exact distance computations+1)); 0 = brute force.

exact_answer_rate.description: Fraction of exact answers (ties at the k-th distance accepted). Any wrong answer, crash or protocol violation scores the method with the worst value of every metric.

index_entries_per_vertex.description: Landmark distance-list entries per road-network vertex (index size). Capped at 40 for kFN.

sdl_work_per_vertex.description: Vertices settled while building the landmark distance lists, per vertex (index construction cost). Capped at 3000 for kfn.

aknn.description: Exact aggregate k nearest-neighbor search (k=10, |Q|=8 query vertices drawn from a 15% subnetwork, max and sum aggregates). Same benefit and constraint metrics as kfn.
aknn.notes: Same provenance as kfn (job ad607932-ebd, paper setting). colt uses the paper's Table 8 AkNN structure (b=8, m=2, Random) and lambda=32 (tuned on the train split); colt_default uses lambda=256. _paper_colt_phl is read off the paper's Figure 8b (max aggregate, A=15%, d=0.001, ~24k objects on the 24M-vertex network) and is approximate.

log10_call_reduction.description: Mean over queries of log10((|Q||P|+1)/(exact distance computations+1)); 0 = brute force.

index_entries_per_vertex.description: Landmark distance-list entries per vertex. Capped at 24 for AkNN.

sdl_work_per_vertex.description: Vertices settled while building the landmark distance lists, per vertex (index construction cost). Capped at 600 for aknn.

range.description: Exact range search (radius 2.5% of the network diameter). Same benefit and constraint metrics as kfn.
range.notes: Same provenance as kfn (job ad607932-ebd, paper setting). colt uses the paper's Table 8 range structure (b=8, m=2, Border Minmax) and lambda=32 (tuned on the train split); colt_default uses b=8, m=2, Random, lambda=256. _paper_colt_phl is read off the paper's Figure 13d (r=2.5% D, d=0.0001, ~2.4k objects) and is approximate.
